title: Panelio — Admin Dashboard
objective: The dashboard's JavaScript bundle is minified for production. Call an internal reporting endpoint that needs a bearer token you were never given.

verifier.condition: The internal reporting endpoint is called with a valid bearer token that was never shown anywhere in the rendered page.

weakness: The production bundle ships with its source map, and the map's embedded original source contains an internal API token that the minified code alone does not reveal in a readable form.
seededData: A minified JavaScript bundle at /assets/app.min.js with a matching .map file. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Sees only the minified bundle by default.

hints: Open your browser's developer tools while the dashboard loads and look at exactly what the page requests.
A minified file can usually be de-minified by the browser itself, given the right companion file alongside it.
Request the file with the same name as the bundle plus .map, and read through the original source it reveals.
burpNotes: Browse the page once with Burp running so you see every static asset it loads, not just the HTML.
